requirements.title: MVBITS argument restrictions
requirements.definition: FROM shall be integer; FROMPOS, LEN, and TOPOS shall be integer and nonnegative; FROMPOS plus LEN shall be at most BIT_SIZE(FROM); TOPOS plus LEN shall be at most BIT_SIZE(TO); TO shall be a variable with the same type and kind type parameter as FROM.

pending.MVBITS-FROM-integer: Positive source control passes integer FROM initialized with INT(B'0111'). A source-control mutation uses noninteger FROM and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MVBITS-FROMPOS-integer-nonnegative: Positive source control uses FROMPOS=2. Source-control mutations use a noninteger FROMPOS and FROMPOS=-1 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MVBITS-LEN-integer-nonnegative: Positive source controls use LEN=0 and LEN=2 with the LEN=2 companion proving a nonvacuous copy. Source-control mutations use noninteger LEN and LEN=-1 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MVBITS-FROMPOS-plus-LEN-in-range: Positive source control uses FROMPOS=2, LEN=2 within BIT_SIZE(FROM). A source-control mutation sets FROMPOS=BIT_SIZE(FROM) with LEN=1 and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.MVBITS-TO-variable-same-type-kind: Positive source control passes an integer variable TO of the same kind as FROM. Source-control mutations pass an expression or a different-kind variable and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MVBITS-TOPOS-integer-nonnegative: Positive source control uses TOPOS=0. Source-control mutations use noninteger TOPOS and TOPOS=-1 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MVBITS-TOPOS-plus-LEN-in-range: Positive source control uses TOPOS=0, LEN=2 within BIT_SIZE(TO). A source-control mutation sets TOPOS=BIT_SIZE(TO) with LEN=1 and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MVBITS copies selected bits and leaves all other TO bits unaltered
requirements.definition: MVBITS defines TO by copying LEN bits starting at FROMPOS of FROM to TOPOS of TO; no other TO bits are altered, and the copied TO bits equal the entry value of the selected FROM bits on return.

pending.MVBITS-copies-selected-bit-sequence: Initialize FROM=INT(B'0111') and TO=INT(B'0110') using BOZ actual arguments to INT, call MVBITS(FROM,2,2,TO,0), and assert BTEST(TO,0), .NOT. BTEST(TO,1), and BTEST(TO,2) in bit context rather than relying on signed numeric interpretation. Mutate FROMPOS so the selected bit checks fail.
pending.MVBITS-preserves-other-TO-bits: Use the same BOZ-initialized case and assert a high-order sentinel bit outside the copied range remains unchanged with BTEST before and after the call. Mutate LEN to include that bit so preservation fails.
pending.MVBITS-zero-length-copy-nonvacuous: Initialize TO with a distinctive BOZ pattern, call MVBITS with LEN=0, and assert several BTEST positions remain unchanged, paired with the LEN=2 copy case so zero-length behavior is not the only observation.
